description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents... “Beach Blessings at Seagrove on 30A”, a stunning 6-bedroom, 6-bathroom coastal sanctuary in the heart of Seagrove Beach. With a private pool, 8 included bikes, dual laundry rooms and room for up to 20 guests, this elegant retreat is perfect for large families or multi-family vacations. Enjoy breezy afternoons on expansive porches, soak up the sun poolside or stroll just 3 minutes to the beach. From its chef’s kitchen to its serene balconies, every detail has been designed for elevated 30A living. Discover all the blessings waiting at Seagrove below… 👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***6 Bedrooms + 6 Bathrooms - Sleeps 20 across beautifully appointed suites and bunk spacesPrivate Pool - Fully fenced with outdoor lounge area and gas grill8 Bikes Included - Cruise Seagrove Beach or nearby Seaside, WaterColor & moreChef’s Kitchen - Dual dishwashers, stainless appliances & bar seating for 52 Laundry Rooms - Full-size washer/dryers on 1st & 3rd floorsSpacious Porches & Balconies - Multiple outdoor spaces for lounging and diningWalk to the Beach - Only 0.2 miles from Seagrove’s sugar-white sands*** LIVING AREAS ***Thoughtfully designed for both gathering and retreating, the living spaces throughout offer comfort and versatility on every floor. Whether it's morning coffee on the porch or evening games in the top-floor lounge, the layout suits every mood.Main living area with ample plush seating and flat-screen TV3rd floor bonus sitting area with sofa, flat-screen TV and a wet bar with mini fridge and coffee makerCovered back porch and balconies on 2nd and 3rd floors for breezy hangouts or quiet momentsGas grill and poolside lounge area for easy outdoor entertainment*** KITCHEN & DINING ***Entertain with ease in the fully equipped kitchen built for big gatherings. With top-tier appliances and smart seating options, mealtime becomes a highlight of your stay.Stainless steel appliances including double dishwashers for large groupsBar seating for 5 at the kitchen island - perfect for snacks and conversationsDining table with seating for 12 - ideal for family-style dinnersEasy access to the back porch and pool for indoor-outdoor flow*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***With six luxurious bedrooms and a variety of en-suite and shared baths, everyone in your group can find their perfect space. A combination of king suites and a large custom bunk room gives flexibility for families, friends and kids of all ages.1st FloorPowder Room - Conveniently located off the entryKing Guest Suite - King Bed, flat-screen TV and En-suite with dual vanities & walk-in shower2nd FloorKing Guest Suite - King Bed, flat-screen TV, balcony access and En-suite with single vanity & walk-in showerKing Guest Suite - King Bed, flat-screen TV, balcony access and En-suite with single vanity & shower/tub comboKing Guest Suite - King Bed, flat-screen TV, balcony access and En-suite with single vanity & walk-in showerBunk Room - 2 Queen-over-Queen Bunks & 1 Twin-over-Twin bunk, flat-screen TV and balcony access3rd FloorPowder Room - Conveniently located off the living areaPrimary King Suite - King Bed, flat-screen TV, private balcony access and En-suite with dual vanities, soaking tub & walk-in shower*** OUTDOOR OASIS ***Outdoor living is at the heart of “Beach Blessings at Seagrove on 30A”. From poolside lounging to balcony dinners, you’ll enjoy fresh air and sunshine at every turn.Private pool with fenced perimeter and poolside seatingGas grill and porch lounge area for afternoon cookoutsMultiple balconies on upper floors, including 3rd floor dining for 68 included bikes to explore the scenic 30A trail system*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Nestled in the heart of Seagrove Beach, you’ll be perfectly positioned to soak up the vibrant culture and breathtaking natural beauty of 30A. From pristine white-sand beaches and turquoise waters to charming local shops and delicious coastal cuisine, everything that makes 30A special will be right at your fingertips.Beach Access: A quick 3-minute walk takes you to Seagrove Beach where soft sand and clear waters create the perfect spot to relax and soak up the sunNearby Restaurants: Savor coastal flavors at Café Thirty-A, enjoy the upscale beachy vibe of Surfing Deer or indulge in local seafood favorites at Old Florida Fish HouseSeaside: Explore the charming and vibrant community of Seaside filled with boutique shops, unique eateries and a laid-back, small-town coastal atmosphereGrayton Beach State Park: Immerse yourself in nature with scenic trails, serene paddling adventures and breathtaking views of the Gulf—you’ll feel a world away from it all*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independentlyWe DO NOT accept wire transfers for paymentWaiver required to get access to the 8 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A EscapesPlease note that their is active construction taking place next door to this property. We do not have a completion date at this time.*** YOUR STAY — OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re dedicated to creating a seamless, luxurious vacation for you and your guests. From spotless homes to 24/7 guest support, we handle every detail so you can focus on relaxing, exploring and soaking in the magic of 30A.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***
